config.label: Bearer token
config.description: Bearer token. Clients that support OAuth should omit this and let discovery run: an unauthenticated request returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate pointing at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, which names https://api.lockally.com as the authorization server (OAuth 2.1, PKCE S256, CIMD). This header is the manual alternative for clients that do not, using a Lockally API key (lk_live_... or lk_test_...).
